headline: Iran halts talks with U.S. over Israeli actions in Lebanon, Gaza
summary: Iran has halted talks with the US over Israeli operations in southern Lebanon and Gaza. Trump said Israel and Hezbollah would stop fighting after the move.
why: US-Iran tensions affect oil supply risk, since the Middle East supplies a large share of global crude.
why_moved: The halt in US-Iran talks adds geopolitical risk in the Middle East, a key oil-producing region. The input does not give a market reaction.
